magicNumbers.Comment: You can use this config to increase/lower the cpu and network load of the server. A Warning though: Changing these numbers might make your server run unstable or slow. Use at your own risk! Until there is an official documentation, feel free to ask in the forums what the numbers do.

tick.source: Official ServerMain.StatsCollector pre-sleep work; integer milliseconds. Effective TPS is completed ticks per wall second, not 1000 / processing time. Percentiles above histogram range are null.

capabilities.name: tickProcessing
capabilities.reason: Official pre-sleep millisecond tick work, not entire Process call including sleep; unavailable if hook disabled/conflicted.

capabilities.name: processCpuMemoryGc
capabilities.reason: Process CPU, GC allocation/collection/total pause counters and process memory sampled at configured cadence.

capabilities.name: mainThreadCpu
capabilities.reason: Optional OS thread CPU; Linux/Windows only; null if thread counters unavailable.

capabilities.name: worldCounts
capabilities.reason: Connected Playing clients, loaded entities and optional inspected dictionary Count; no chunk copies or entity walks.

capabilities.name: loadedChunks
capabilities.reason: Internal 1.22.7 loadedChunks dictionary count, sampled without cloning or retaining terrain objects.

capabilities.name: networkPayloadCounters
capabilities.reason: Engine aggregate sent/received TCP+UDP payload byte counters; excludes OS framing and per-player rates.

capabilities.name: systemTimings
capabilities.reason: Optional sampled inclusive ServerSystem.OnServerTick methods, identified by engine type.

capabilities.name: phaseTimings
capabilities.reason: Optional entity tick loop, callback dispatch, autosave preparation and main-thread packet dispatch; inclusive samples.

capabilities.name: registeredCallbackCosts
capabilities.reason: Optional inspected official callback wrappers, attributed by callback assembly/type/method; bounded unique methods.

capabilities.name: aiAndPathfindingBreakdown
capabilities.reason: Entity loop includes AI but per-AI/worker timing is deferred pending representative profiling and hook overhead evidence.

capabilities.name: chunkGenerationAndIoTimings
capabilities.reason: Worker-thread chunk generation, serialization and disk completions are not instrumented; queued chunk-column count is available.

capabilities.name: blockEntityIndividualCosts
capabilities.reason: Callbacks can be sampled by method with callbackTimings; individual block identities are not recorded.

capabilities.name: fullSaveDuration
capabilities.reason: Optional autosave preparation timing excludes asynchronous serialization/disk completion; no full-save latency claim.

capabilities.name: packetQueuesAndPlayerSync
capabilities.reason: Engine payload counters and optional inclusive packet dispatch do not measure queue latency or per-player synchronization.

capabilities.name: correctnessAndThroughput
capabilities.reason: Requires external authoritative scenario evidence, actual clients and before/after world validation.

capabilities.name: sessionEvidence
capabilities.reason: Optional opt-in Playing-session UID events only; no automated interaction success is asserted. Dropped/capped/failed evidence is incomplete.

modules.name: blockEntities
modules.reason: This gameplay area is not modified by the implemented engine modules.

modules.name: callbackTimings
modules.reason: Optional sampled callback attribution, bounded by MaxHotspots.

modules.name: chunkOptimization
modules.reason: This gameplay area is not modified by the implemented engine modules.

modules.name: entityOptimization
modules.reason: AI filter dispatch and repulsion hot paths are separate engine modules. Entity activation and AI scheduling remain unchanged.

modules.name: memoryManagement
modules.reason: This gameplay area is not modified by the implemented engine modules.

modules.name: networking
modules.reason: This gameplay area is not modified by the implemented engine modules.

modules.name: scheduling
modules.reason: This gameplay area is not modified by the implemented engine modules.

modules.name: tickMetrics
modules.reason: Capture stopped; hooks removed, measurements retained.

overhead.caveat: Self-timing excludes Harmony dispatch, exports and observer effects. Compare matching profiler-disabled/enabled trials to measure total overhead.

notes: Engine-patch preview. Module activation is recorded separately; gameplay scheduling remains unchanged.
Process CPU is percent of one logical core and may exceed 100%. Main-thread work utilization is wall-time processing, not CPU utilization.
System/phase/callback timings are opt-in inclusive samples. Totals cover sampled calls only and are not extrapolated.
GC committed and fragmentation describe the most recent GC; managedHeapBytes is the current approximate live allocation estimate, not a retained-object census.
Network counters are engine-reported packet payload bytes, not physical-interface throughput. No per-player attribution is claimed.
Historical samples are bounded; overwritten count is explicit. Tick histogram covers the full capture.

correctness.reason: Collect authoritative interaction and workload evidence separately; these metrics do not prove correctness or player capacity.
